To report your income or tell us you've met your mutual obligation requirements, call the [Centrelink Reporting Line](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/phone-us?context=64107#reportincome).

Monday to Friday 8 am to 8 pm

Monday to Friday 8 am to 5 pm

Monday to Friday 9 am to 5 pm

Call [+613 6222 3455](tel:+61362223455) (calls to this number are not free) if either:

[136 240](tel:136240)

Before your phone, make sure you have your CRN or CAN handy. When calling, you'll need a voiceprint. You can create one when you call.

Monday to Friday 8 am to 4:30 pm

#### Waiting on your claim to be processed?
If you’ve found a scam impersonating us, you can report it by forwarding it or taking a screenshot and emailing it to [reportascam@servicesaustralia.gov.au](mailto:reportascam@servicesaustralia.gov.au).

web.title: What are the Centrelink phone self service options
web.description: Call 136 240 to: check payment information, such as past and future payments; apply for an advance payment; hear your Working Credit or Income Bank balance.
